_: The seasonal calendar (Leslie, 2026-09-25): when each festival's bonus lesson is offered, and to learners of which course. Lunar festivals move, so every year's date is written out — add the next years here, never compute them. A lesson is offered from `before` days ahead of the day to `after` days after it, on the learner's own calendar. This file is also what a future push-notification sender reads to announce a festival (docs/NOTIFICATIONS-PLAN.md: content announcements, opt-in).
